stories.title: 'We're being used': Cleveland council members clash over Deshaun Watson turkey giveaway, sparking debate over PR and accountability
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson's Thanksgiving turkey giveaway is sparking debate in Cleveland City Hall over charity, accountability and public image.

stories.title: Chicago Bulls beat Cleveland Cavaliers 122-108 behind Jordan Hawkins' 19 points and 63 off the bench
stories.summary: Jordan Hawkins scored a season-high 19 points, Buddy Hield had 17 and the Bulls got 63 points off the bench as they held on to beat the Cavaliers 122-108.

stories.title: Shinto Japanese Steakhouse & Sushi Bar to open first East Side location this week
stories.summary: Shinto Japanese Steakhouse & Sushi Bar will open its first location on the East Side of Greater Cleveland at Legacy Village in Lyndhurst on Wednesday.

stories.title: Ohio State Highway Patrol: 5 injured, including infant, in Uhrichsville crash
stories.summary: A 10-month-old baby was among those seriously injured in an Uhrichsville car crash late Monday afternoon, according to the Ohio State Highway Patrol.

stories.title: Thanksgiving side dish showdown: Mike Polk Jr. discovers Northeast Ohio's favorites — and least favorites
stories.summary: DoorDash says green beans are Ohio's favorite Thanksgiving side dish. But when Mike Polk Jr. took his own informal poll, Northeast Ohioans had different opinions.

stories.title: A Cleveland organization rewards those who don't drink and drive. Here's their message ahead of 'Blackout Wednesday'
stories.summary: The Cleveland chapter of The Bar Fairies aims to prevent drunk driving by leaving gift cards and notes on the windshields of those who choose not to drink and drive.

stories.title: Akron man pleads guilty to fatally running over brother with car
stories.summary: Philip Mayfield has pleaded guilty to involuntary manslaughter in connection with the death of his brother Charles Jefferson this past March in Akron.

stories.title: Man sentenced for stealing nearly $500K in equipment from Canton med spa
stories.summary: Timothey McCrary, 42, admitted to stealing nearly $500,000 worth of equipment from a Canton medical spa and selling the stolen items to a med spa in Florida.

stories.title: Cleveland students push CMSD to recognize multiple valedictorians, salutatorians after school mergers
stories.summary: A Campus International senior dropped from No. 1 in her class to 11th after merging with John Hay. Now, students want changes to how academic honors are awarded.

stories.title: Crews respond to 'heavy fire' at 2-story Akron home; partial roof collapse reported
stories.summary: The Lake Street home was unoccupied at the time of the fire. Akron's Fire Investigation Unit was called in to investigate.

stories.title: 'Their influence spanned continents': Oberlin College remembers professor and his wife at memorial service weeks after their murders
stories.summary: The Oberlin College community gathered at Finney Chapel to remember Pipo Nguyen-Duy and Tran Thi Nam Phong, both shot and killed inside their home in October.

stories.title: Suspect connected to deadly baby shower shooting in Parma makes initial court appearance: Watch video as he faced a judge
stories.summary: The three people who died in the baby shower shooting were 17, 19 and 45 years old. Deangelo Townsend has been charged with murder. His bond was set at $1 million.
